answer: Each newcomer crosses one bridge onto the tundra, locks a 70-credit bond in the vault, and burns a 55-credit join fee; the fee is destroyed. A receipt records the burn, bound to one key, and the public tundra ledger lists every receipt for audit. A rented receipt bears the lender's vault seal, so both bonds burn. Forging 1,000 identities burns 55,000 and locks 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 55 once and keeps its full share.
